title: Partnering With Employees | J.P. Morgan
description: SUBSCRIBE: http://jpm.com/x/i/NFPWfK0  Yong's role as a Human Resources Business Partner is to help employees reach the next level of their careers, support the business and work on regional projects.  About J.P. Morgan: J.P. Morgan is a leader in financial services, offering solutions to clients in more than 100 countries with one of the most comprehensive global product platforms available. We have been helping our clients to do business and manage their wealth for more than 200 years. Our business has been built upon our core principle of putting our clients' interests first. asr.full_text: My role as a business partner is actually to support human resources function in Singapore. and also to carry out location-wide projects. So that includes looking at our policies, doing risk and controlling self-assessments. and also to prepare HR updates to the Singapore Management Committee and Operating Committee. There's always an opportunity for efficiency and technology use in the environment. So when you make things faster or smoother for clients, it helps to increase profits and keep profits. So it's really exciting to be a part of it and feel like you're making a difference. because you're causing business.
